title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Adding and Dropping Courses
Adding
Courses
:
12-week
Terms
: A course must be added no later than 10 business days from the beginning of term. This
regulation applies to spring term, fall term, and winter term (12-week terms).
6-week Terms: A course must be added no later than 5 business days from the beginning of the term. This
regulation applies to Intersession, Summer Session, Fall 6-week (first) and Winter 6-week (first).
Fall 6-week (second): A course must be added no later than three business days before November 1.
Winter 6-week (second): A course must be added no later than three business days before February 1.
Students
should consult the Academic Dates to view the actual dates.
Courses may not be added after the specified deadline date. In exceptional cases a Petitions Committee
may grant a petition to waive the regulation.
Consult the Academic Petitions website for more information.
Students may add courses and using LORIS. Students should ensure that a course add has been completed
by checking their academic record on LORIS. Courses adds that cannot be completed using LORIS can be
submitted to Enrolment Services, through the Service Laurier website.
Dropping Courses:
All
courses can by dropped through LORIS.
Students
should confirm that a course drop has been processed by checking their academic
record on LORIS. If LORIS does now allow a course drop, students may submit a
Drop Course Request Form to Enrolment Services (available on the Enrolment
Services website). All course drops are subject to university regulations and
published deadlines. The onus of dropping a course rests solely upon the
student. Ceasing to attend lectures, even if the instructor is informed, does
not formally constitute a dropped course and will result in a failing grade.
The final dates to drop a course(s) for possible tuition adjustment (assessed at course rate) are:
Fall term (12-weeks)
two-thirds of course, 40th teaching day
Winter term (12-weeks)
two-thirds of course, 40th teaching day
Fall and Winter (6-weeks, first and second)
two-thirds of course, 20th teaching day
Intersession, Summer Session (6-weeks)
two-thirds of course, 20th teaching day
Spring term (12-weeks)
two-thirds of course, 40th teaching day
Courses of different durations will be pro-rated.
Consult the
Academic Dates
for the actual dates to drop a course(s)
for possible tuition adjustment (assessed at course rate)
. If the normal
deadline date falls on a Friday, the actual deadline will become the following business day.
Final day to Drop a Course without Failure:
The final day to drop a
course(s) without failure is the last day of class of the term, identified in
the academic dates as the Classes End date. Students remain responsible for
100% tuition for courses dropped after final day to drop for possible tuition
adjustment (assessed at course rate) until 11:59 pm EST on the final day to
drop a course without failure. After the final day to drop a course without
failure, courses may not be dropped. In exceptional cases, a Petitions
Committee may grant a petition to waive the regulation. Consult the Academic
Petitions website for more information.
Dropping a Course After the Deadline (Grade of DR)
:
A student may request to drop a course after the final day to drop a course without failure, but
before the start of the exam period. A grade of DR (dropped-failure) will be assigned to the course(s)
requested. To make this request, a student may email Enrolment Services (through the
Service Laurier
website
) with the course code and section, and indicate that they accept the grade of DR.
Request to Change Course Registration to Audit:
A change from registration for credit to audit must be made no later than the final day to drop for possible tuition adjustment. This request can be made by completing the Audit Course Form on the Enrolment Services website.
The Faculty teaching or department of the course must provide permission for a student to audit a
course.
